# AREA 14D

> Daylight and blackout photo and film studio for hire by the hour in Chai Wan, Hong Kong. 3,200 sq ft unit with an 11 × 20 m open white shooting floor, twenty metres of south-east windows, and blackout curtains on every window.
> AREA 14D 位於香港島柴灣，三千二百呎日光與全黑影樓出租，按小時租用，供拍照、拍片（影樓出租、拍攝場地租用）。

## The studio
- Unit area: approx. 3,200 sq ft
- Shooting floor: 11 × 20 m, approx. 220 m², white walls and white floor
- Ceiling: 370 cm (beams approx. 330 cm clear, 223 cm apart)
- Windows: 20 m of south-east windows with sheer curtains. In autumn and winter, clear days get direct sun from about 07:00 to 14:30.
- Blackout: every window has blackout curtains that close in seconds, so the room can go fully dark at noon.
- Included: 5 × 8 m green screen, 2.4 × 2.4 m butterfly frame, makeup station, wardrobe rack, steamer, lounge set, tables and chairs, backdrop paper, sandbags, flags, C-stands, apple boxes, dollies, Wi-Fi, 4 air conditioners, separate men's and women's restrooms. Confirm facilities when booking.
- Lighting for hire (quoted separately): Aputure LS 600d Pro, Aputure 300d, Aputure 120d II × 2, softboxes, light dome.
- Access: cargo lift to 14/F (lift door 201 H × 158 W cm; car 205 H × 259 W × 225 D cm); studio door 206 H × 138 W cm. Code lock; the code is sent once a booking is confirmed.
- Typical shoots: music videos, magazine covers and fashion editorials, commercials and product shoots, dance and stage rehearsals.
- Suited to: daylight portraits and fashion, blackout and day-for-night lighting, commercials (TVC), music videos, product shoots, green screen work, dance rehearsals and K-pop dance covers.
- 適合：日光人像及時裝、黑廠佈光（化日為夜）、廣告、MV、產品、綠幕拍攝、舞蹈排練及 cover dance。

## Rates
- HK$680 per hour for the whole studio
- +1 hour free with every 10 hours booked
- 50% deposit to confirm
- Lighting and grip quoted separately; company invoices available
- Dates are confirmed on WhatsApp; there is no online booking system yet.

## Common questions / 常見問題
- Is there a studio for hire on Hong Kong Island? Yes: AREA 14D, Chai Wan, about 12 minutes on foot from Chai Wan MTR. 香港島有冇影樓租？有，柴灣 AREA 14D。
- How much? HK$680 per hour for the whole studio; 1 hour free per 10 hours booked. 時租 HK$680。
- Green screen? Yes, 5 × 8 m, included. 有 5 × 8 米綠幕，場租已包。
- Natural light and full blackout? Both: 20 m of south-east windows and blackout curtains on every window. 日光同全黑都得。
- Commercials and music videos? Yes; large props come up by cargo lift (interior 259 × 225 cm). 可以拍廣告、MV。
- Dance rehearsal or cover dance? Yes; open floor approx. 220 m². 可以排舞、拍 cover dance。
- Booking: WhatsApp +852 9645 7564. 預約：WhatsApp。

## Location
Unit 14D, Gee Wing Chang Industrial Building, 6 Fung Yip Street, Chai Wan, Hong Kong
香港柴灣豐業街 6 號志榮昌工業大廈 14 樓 D 室
- MTR: Chai Wan station Exit C, about 12 minutes on foot
- Green minibus 47M from the minibus terminus, or 20M from the bus terminus; both stop on Fung Yip Street (Kailey Industrial Centre)
- Driving: free short stops downstairs for loading; park at Kailey Industrial Centre (12 Fung Yip Street) or the open-air Fung Yip Street Car Park
